digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify workflow, full-route job cancellation
propositions: GitHub re-evaluates job-level if conditions during workflow cancellation; jobs with always() predicates remain true and do not cancel even when a replacement workflow run exists.

Commit 6f4123678c added always() predicates to seven full-route jobs, causing stale matrix/reusable jobs to consume 1,785 runner-seconds and delay successor job creation by 1,510 seconds after replacement existed.
Full-route job predicates must become ineligible when workflow is canceled while remaining eligible when classifier fails in an uncanceled run.

The fix replaces the leading always() status check with a !cancelled() predicate, preserving classifier-result and route conditions, so docs-only classification and classifier-failure fallback remain fail-closed.
Live post-merge organic patchset replacements demonstrate stale full-route jobs now stop within 60-110 seconds of replacement creation instead of running to natural matrix completion.
